resources.string:
For drawing boxes and arrows: an organisation, a loop, what feeds what.
## What it does
- Draws them at the phone's width, top to bottom or bottom to top
- Groups boxes, one group inside another, folded with a touch
- A box can link to a thing of the app, whose current name it shows, and open it
## Not made for
- A timeline (Agenda), a table (Records), figures (Chart)

## The schema
- Direction: top to bottom, or bottom to top

## Boxes
- Id: the short name arrows and groups use
- Text: what the box says
- Link: a thing of the app, whose name the box shows when it has no text
- Shape, Color, Texture

## Arrows
- From, To: two boxes
- Text on the arrow, Line, Arrowhead

## Groups
- Id, Title
- Contents: boxes and other groups
- Starts folded

## The schema
Touch a linked box to open what it designates, a box whose text is cut to read it whole.
Touch a group's title to fold or unfold it, for this visit: nothing is saved.
To change the schema, open its config.

A diagram in the vocabulary of Mermaid flowcharts, stored as JSON, never as Mermaid text; convert any Mermaid text you are given. Written for a phone held upright: direction TD or BT only, about ten boxes readable at a glance, short labels. When a box stands for a thing of the app, set its thing rather than a label, so that it follows its name. Arrows join boxes, never groups. Keeps no entries.
